#ifndef ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_TEST_H_
#define ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_TEST_H_

#include <zephyr/ztest.h>
#include <zephyr/sys/iterable_sections.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/**
 * @brief Test suite structure.
 */
struct ztest_suite {
	const char *name;
	/** Predicate function to be run before the test suite is run */
	bool (*predicate)(const void *data);
	/** Test suite setup function */
	void (*setup)(void *data);
	/** Test suite teardown function */
	void (*teardown)(void *data);
	/** Test case setup function */
	void (*before)(void *data);
	/** Test case teardown function */
	void (*after)(void *data);
	/** Pointer to the array of test cases */
	struct ztest_unit_test *unit_tests;
	/** User data to be passed to the test suite functions */
	void *user_data;
};

#if defined(CONFIG_ZTEST_SHUFFLE)
#define ZTEST_SHUFFLE_SECTION K_SHUFFLE_SECTION
#else
#define ZTEST_SHUFFLE_SECTION
#endif

/**
 * @internal
 * @brief Define a test suite.
 *
 * This is the internal macro that is used to define a test suite. It is not
 * meant to be used directly by users.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param predicate The predicate function to be run before the test suite is run.
 * @param setup The test suite setup function.
 * @param teardown The test suite teardown function.
 * @param before The test case setup function.
 * @param after The test case teardown function.
 * @param user_data The user data to be passed to the test suite functions.
 * @param ... A list of @ref ztest_unit_test calls.
 */
#define ZTEST_SUITE_DEFINE(suite, predicate, setup, teardown, before, after, user_data, ...) \
	static struct ztest_unit_test suite##_tests[] ZTEST_SHUFFLE_SECTION = { \
		__VA_ARGS__ \
		ZTEST_UNIT_TEST(ztest_test_pass) /* Array terminator */ \
	}; \
	STRUCT_SECTION_ITERABLE(ztest_suite, suite##_suite) = { \
		.name = #suite, \
		.predicate = predicate, \
		.unit_tests = suite##_tests, \
		.setup = setup, \
		.teardown = teardown, \
		.before = before, \
		.after = after, \
		.user_data = user_data, \
	}

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite with setup and teardown functions.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param setup The test suite setup function.
 * @param teardown The test suite teardown function.
 * @param ... A list of @ref ztest_unit_test calls.
 */
#define ztest_test_suite_pre_post(suite, setup, teardown, ...) \
	ZTEST_SUITE_DEFINE(suite, NULL, setup, teardown, NULL, NULL, NULL, __VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite with a setup function.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param setup The test suite setup function.
 * @param ... A list of @ref ztest_unit_test calls.
 */
#define ztest_test_suite_pre(suite, setup, ...) \
	ZTEST_SUITE_DEFINE(suite, NULL, setup, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, __VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite with a teardown function.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param teardown The test suite teardown function.
 * @param ... A list of @ref ztest_unit_test calls.
 */
#define ztest_test_suite_post(suite, teardown, ...) \
	ZTEST_SUITE_DEFINE(suite, NULL, NULL, teardown, NULL, NULL, NULL, __VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite with user data.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param user_data The user data to be passed to the test suite functions.
 * @param predicate The predicate function to be run before the test suite is run.
 * @param setup The test suite setup function.
 * @param before The test case setup function.
 * @param after The test case teardown function.
 * @param teardown The test suite teardown function.
 * @param ... A list of @ref ztest_unit_test calls.
 */
#define ztest_test_suite_with_user_data(suite, user_data, predicate, setup, before, after, \
					teardown, ...) \
	ZTEST_SUITE_DEFINE(suite, predicate, setup, teardown, before, after, user_data, __VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param ... A list of @ref ztest_unit_test calls.
 */
#define ztest_test_suite(suite, ...) \
	ZTEST_SUITE_DEFINE(suite, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, __VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Get a test suite by name.
 *
 * @param suite_name The name of the test suite to get.
 *
 * @return A pointer to the test suite, or NULL if not found.
 */
struct ztest_suite *ztest_get_test_suite_by_name(const char *suite_name);

/**
 * @brief Run a test suite by name.
 *
 * @param suite_name The name of the test suite to run.
 *
 * @return The number of failed tests.
 */
int ztest_run_test_suite_by_name(const char *suite_name);

/**
 * @brief Run a test suite.
 *
 * @param suite The test suite to run.
 *
 * @return The number of failed tests.
 */
#define ztest_run_test_suite(suite) \
	ztest_run_test_suite_by_name(STRINGIFY(suite))

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_TEST_H_ */
